name: Phulka (plain roti)
instructions: Knead atta with salt and water into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.|Divide into 6 balls and roll thin.|Cook on a hot tawa and puff over the flame.

name: Chapati with ghee
description: Whole wheat flatbread brushed with ghee.
instructions: Knead atta with salt and water; rest 15 minutes.|Roll 6 chapatis and cook on a hot tawa.|Brush each with ghee.

name: Dal tadka
description: Toor dal tempered with ghee, cumin, garlic and spices.
instructions: Pressure-cook rinsed toor dal with turmeric and salt until soft.|Heat ghee; add cumin, garlic, ginger and green chilli.|Add onion and tomato and cook until soft; add chilli powder.|Pour the tadka over the dal and simmer 5 minutes.

name: Moong dal
description: Moong dal with a light cumin tempering.
instructions: Cook rinsed moong with turmeric and salt until soft.|Temper with ghee and cumin and stir in.

name: Steamed rice
instructions: Rinse the rice.|Cook in water until tender and drain or absorb.

name: Jeera rice
description: Rice cooked with ghee and cumin.
instructions: Heat ghee and splutter cumin.|Add rinsed rice, salt and water; cook until tender.

name: Aloo gobi
instructions: Heat oil; add cumin and ginger.|Add onion and cook until golden; add tomato and spices.|Add potato and cauliflower; cover and cook until tender.|Garnish with coriander leaves.

name: Aloo palak
instructions: Blanch and chop the spinach.|Heat oil; add cumin and garlic; cook onion and tomato.|Add potato and spices; cook until tender, then add spinach.

name: Bhindi masala
description: Okra stir-fried with onion and spices.
instructions: Wash and dry okra completely; slice.|Heat mustard oil; cook onion until soft.|Add okra and spices; cook uncovered until tender.

name: Rajma masala
instructions: Soak rajma overnight; pressure-cook until soft.|Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil; add tomato and spices.|Add rajma with some cooking water; simmer 15 minutes.

name: Chole masala
instructions: Soak chana overnight; pressure-cook until soft.|Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil; add tomato and spices.|Add chana; simmer 15 minutes.

name: Idli
description: Steamed fermented rice and urad cakes.
instructions: Soak rice and urad separately for 6 hours; grind and mix with salt.|Ferment overnight.|Steam in idli moulds for 10-12 minutes.

name: Plain dosa
description: Thin fermented rice and urad crepe.
instructions: Soak, grind and ferment rice and urad with salt.|Spread a ladle of batter thin on a hot tawa.|Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

name: Besan chilla
instructions: Whisk besan with water, salt and turmeric into a batter.|Stir in onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.|Cook thin pancakes with a little oil.

name: Moong dal chilla
instructions: Soak moong 4 hours; grind with ginger, chilli and salt.|Cook thin pancakes with a little oil.

name: Moong dal khichdi
instructions: Rinse rice and moong together.|Heat ghee; splutter cumin; add turmeric.|Add rice, moong, salt and water; pressure-cook until soft.

name: Curd rice
description: Rice mixed with curd and a mustard tempering.
instructions: Cook the rice soft and let it cool.|Mix with curd and salt.|Temper mustard seeds, ginger and green chilli in oil and pour over.

name: Cucumber raita
instructions: Whisk curd with salt.|Stir in grated cucumber and roasted cumin.

name: Chicken curry
instructions: Cook onion in oil until golden; add ginger and garlic.|Add tomato and spices and cook until the oil separates.|Add chicken and salt; cover and cook until done.

name: Egg curry
instructions: Boil and peel the eggs.|Cook onion, ginger and garlic in oil; add tomato and spices.|Add the eggs and a little water; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Masala omelette
description: Two-egg omelette with onion and tomato.
instructions: Beat eggs with salt.|Stir in onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.|Cook in a little oil on both sides.

name: Rava upma
description: Semolina cooked with vegetables and a mustard tempering.
instructions: Dry-roast the rava.|Temper mustard seeds, chilli and ginger in oil; cook onion and peas.|Add water and salt; bring to a boil and stir in the rava until thick.
